name: Crazy 4 Poker
description: Crazy 4 Poker (Buy Your Card) is a stud poker variant where players ante, receive five cards (two down, three up), then have three rounds of buying followed by betting. Players can pay 1, 2, 3, or 4 units to replace a card from four options (three face-up cards and the top of the deck). High-low with declaration; best hand wins.

Country/Region of Origin: USA
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
Standard 52-card deck, poker chips for ante and betting.
Five cards per player: two face down (hole cards), three face up. Dealer then places three cards face up in a row and the deck face down at the end. Dealing pattern: clockwise.
